resume.summary: Software engineer focused on automation, applied AI, and developer tooling, with example experience in Python, C/C++, computer vision prototypes, Raspberry Pi workflows, and testable backend services.

project.title: Computer Vision Defect Detection Demo
project.description: Built a prototype image-classification workflow for detecting visual defects in sample images.

highlights.bullet: Prepared a labeled sample dataset with repeatable preprocessing and augmentation scripts.
Trained a baseline model and summarized evaluation results for future iteration.
Documented setup steps, known limitations, and recommended next experiments.

project.title: Raspberry Pi Sensor Dashboard
project.description: Built a small-device workflow for collecting sensor readings, logging events, and displaying status.

highlights.bullet: Implemented structured logging and threshold-based alerts for important status changes.
Created a lightweight dashboard to show recent readings and device health.
Added configuration files and setup notes to support repeatable deployment.

responsibilities.bullet: Built a Python toolkit that wrapped a C-style device API for common integration workflows.
Automated documentation generation from structured metadata so examples stayed aligned with API changes.
Added unit tests and sample notebooks covering setup, command execution, and error handling.
Built internal tools for data cleanup, report generation, and task tracking using Python scripts.
Helped prototype image-processing workflows using OpenCV, PyTorch, and repeatable evaluation notes.
Translated informal project requests into scoped tasks, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.
